page.layout: Two columns side by side, a Hebrew-Latin lexicon page. Left column: entries from "בְּמַשְׁאָן" to the foot. Right column: entries from "verti." to "dispōnens". No notes in the margins, no text below the columns.

main_text.l: בְּמַשְׁאָן [?] in solitudine, No. f. m. Rad. שָׁאָה vastari.
מַשְׁאוֹת [?], & מַשֵּׁאוֹת [?] vasti-tates, No. pl. fæm. Rad. שָׁאָה.
מַשְׁאֵיהֶם à vastationibus ipsorum, No. pl. m. præf. & aff. qu. à f. m. שְׁאָה, Rad. שָׁאָה.
מִשְׁאֲלוֹת petitiones, מִשְׁאֲלוֹתֶיךָ tuæ, No. pl. f. aff. Rad. שָׁאַל petiit.
מִשְׁאַרְתְּךָ mactra tua, מִשְׁאֲרוֹתֶיךָ mactræ tuæ, No. f. & pl. f. aff. à sing. fæm. מִשְׁאָרָה, Rad. שָׁאַר superesse.
מַשָּׂאת onus, No. f. f. Rad. נָשָׂא.
מַשָּׂאת ab elevando, מַשְּׂאָתוֹ de excellentia ejus, Infin. Kal, vel No. Infin. שָׂאת ferre, præf. & aff. Rad. נָשָׂא.
מִשְׁבָּה aversu, aversio, מִשְׁבֹּתֵיהֶם aversiones ipsorum, No. f. & pl. fæm. aff. Rad. שׁוּב re-
מַשְׁבִּית cessare faciens, Part. Hiph. f. m. R. שָׁבַת.
מַשְׁבֵּר matrix, No. f. m. Rad. שָׁבַר fregit.
מַשְׁגֶּה errare faciens, Part. Hiph. sing. m. sed, מִשְׁגֶּה error, No. f. m. Rad. שָׁגָה.
מַשְׁגִּיא augens, Part. Hiph. f. m. R. שָׁגָא.
מַשֶּׂגֶת assequatur, Part. Hiph. f. f. R. נָשַׂג.
מַשָּׁרֵד vastans, Part. Piel, f. m. R. שָׁרַד.
מַשֶּׁה mutuum dans, constr. מַשֵּׁה, Part. Hiph. f. m. Rad. נָשָׁה.
מְשׁוֹאָה devastatio, No. f. f. Rad. שָׁאָה vastati.
מְשׁוּבָּב restituens, redux, Part. Piel, f. m. & f. Rad. שׁוּב.
מְשׁוּבַת perversitas, No. f. f. constr. R. שׁוּב.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and several consonants are worn or blurred on this scan; forms marked [?] are my best reading and should be checked against a clean copy. The left-column opening "בְּמַשְׁאָן" and the forms "מַשְׁאוֹת", "מַשֵּׁאוֹת" are doubtful. The page number at top left is faint. The bottom line of the right column breaks off ("Part. Pi-" / "el,"), and the rest is not visible. The right column's first line ("verti.") is the end of a gloss from the line above, which is cut off at the top. Hebrew running heads are read from the faint print at the top corners.
